tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab mo yang tig gi dkar chag nyi zla gza' skar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

zab mo yang tig gi dkar chag nyi zla gza' skar zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen 'od kyi snye ma'i phreng tshogs can/ /mtshan stong gis 'bar dpe byad bzang pos spras/ /mgon po don gnyis rdzogs pa'i bcom ldan la/ /dad brgya'i gtsug gi 'dab stong g.yo bas mchod/ /rgyal ba kun gyis thugs kyi gsang ba che/ /rdo rje rtse mo lhun gyis grub dbyings las/ /mngon sum snying tig nges don gnad bsdus te/ /zab mo yang tig dkar chag gsal bar bya/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po rdo rje'i dbyings/ /thig le mchog gsang bla na med pa'i gnas/ /bshad dpe'i rgyud dang snyan brgyud gnyis su bsdus/ /de don nges pa gnas 'dir bstan pa las/ /dang po bshad rgyud nges pa rdo rje'i chings/ /sngon 'gro dbang khrid rgyab chos bzhir shes bya/ /gdams khrid nyams len kun gyi sngon 'gro'i chos/ / thog mar lo rgyus 'od kyi phreng ba yis/ /zab mo'i chos la ngo mtshar yid ches bstan/ /brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /rang rgyud rnam dag snod du rung bar byed/ /gsol 'debs rim pa bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dngos su 'pho bar bstan/ /maṇ+ḍal rim pa gling bzhi rgyan gyur gyis/ /tshogs chen rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis byang bar bstan/ /paṇa chen gu ru'i bi ma'i sgrub thabs kyis/ /zab mo'i chos dang byin rlabs gsang sgo 'byed/ /snying po ye shes bla ma'i sgrubs pa yis/ /smin grol zab mo'i de nyid mngon du byed/ /de ltar sngon 'gro nges pa'i chos drug gis/ /nyams len mthar phyin dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs/ /med du mi rung shin tu gces par bstan/ /smin par byed pa dbang gis rim pa la/ /spros bcas dbang chog dngos grub chu bo yis/ /rdos bcas lus sbyong rdo rje'i skur smin byed/ /de yi gnad yig ming gi rigs byed kyis/

/so so'i rigs chen gang yin mngon du shes/ spros med dbang chog klong gsal chu bo yis/ / 'khrul pa'i ngag sbyong rdo rje'i gsung smin byed/ /de yi gnad yig bum pa'i brda don gyis/ /don gyi snying po gdod ma'i gzhi mtshon byed/ /shin tu spros med ye shes chu bo yis/ /'khrul rtog sems sbyong rdo rje'i thugs smin byed/ / rab tu spros med byin rlabs chu bo yis/ /sgrib kun rnam dag 'od gsal mngon du byed/ /de dag yan lag dam tshig gsum bkod kyis/ /gsang sngags 'dul ba spang blang mtshams shes byed/ /de ltar smin byed dbang gi chos bdun gyis/ /lam gyi gzhi 'dings ma smin smin byed pas/ /gsang mchog rgyal por med pa'i thabs med pas/ /de yi gnad du 'di kun tshang bar bstan/ /dam pa'i phyag bzhes yin no e ma ho/ /grol byed gdams khrid nges pa'i chos tshan la/ /thun mong sngon 'gro rin chen pra khrid kyis/ /zab mo'i don rnams rim kyis 'jug par bstan/ /dngos gzhi'i don khrid sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyis/ /gsang chen nges pa'i lam gyi snying po bstan/ /gzhi gnas ma bcos de bzhin ngo sprod kyis/ khregs chod don khrid ka dag chos zad bstan/ /ar gtad mun khrid 'od gsal 'khor lo yis/ /mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor mchog tu gsang ba bstan/ /de ltar grol byed khrid kyi chos bzhi yis/ /rnal 'byor 'bras bu tshe gcig nges pa'i gnad/ /med du mi rung shin tu gces pas na/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i chos bzhi e ma ho/ /kun gyi rgyab chos nges pa'i rnam grangs la/ khyung chen gshog rdzogs don gyi dgongs pa bstan/ /bla med spyi babs gdams pa'i spyi chings bstan/ /zab mo'i bcud bsdus dgongs pa'i yin tshul bstan/ /'od gsal snying pos gdangs gsum nyams len bstan/ /nges don snying pos dgongs pa'i la bzla bstan/ /don gyi snying pos dgongs pa'i 'phyong chen bstan/

/gzhi lam 'bras bus gdams pa'i yin tshul bstan/ /rnal 'byor bzhi rim nyams len snying po bstan/ / zab mo pra khṛd gdams pa'i gnad 'gags bstan/ /snying po'i yang bcud 'chugs med gzer bu bstan/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa rtsal sbyong bogs 'byin bstan/ /dus kyi gsal byed 'chi ba brtag bslu bstan/ /'da' kha don gyi 'chi dus khyer so bstan/ /btags grol snying pos ma bsgoms sangs rgyas bstan/ /zab don snying pos gdams pa'i yang zhun bstan/ /tshig don snying pos man ngag gnas rnams bstan/ /gdams khrid mdo chings ji ltar gdams tshul bstan/ /de ltar rgyab chos rnam grangs bco brgyad kyis/ / nyams len gnad rnams 'chugs med gtan la phab/ /tshang la ma nor nges pa'i snying por bstan/ /gcig la kun tshang kun la'ang gcig dgos pas/ / me long dum bu gzugs kyi yan lag bzhin/ /med thabs med pa gnad kyi man ngag tu/ /gsang ba'i rgyab chos ngo mtshar e ma ho/ /de dag kun gyi dpe brgyud ngais pa'i don/ /bshad brgyud snying po rdzogs par bstan pa ste/ /bcu bdun rgyud dang btags grol rgyud gsum dang*/ /brgya dang bcu bdun yang zab po ti bzhi/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i thims dang bcas/ /ma lus kun gyi snying po'i bcud bsdus nas/ /'dir gcig nges pas yang zab snying por bkod/ /bshad dpe'i don brgyud ngo mtshar e ma ho/ / ༈ snyan rgyud snying po don gyi man ngag la/ /sngon 'gro dbang khrid rgyab chos rnam bzhi las/ /thog mar sngon 'gro nges pa'i chos tshan la/ /gnad kyi mdo chings gdams pa'i 'debs tshul bstan/ /byin brlabs sprin phung brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal bstan/ /dngos grub char 'bebs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bstan/ /de phyir sngon 'gro nges pa'i chos gsum gyis/ /gdams tshul byin rlabs snod du rung bar bstan/ /nyams len grogs su shin tu gces pas na/ /med pa'i thabs med ngo mtshar e ma ho/

/smin par byed pa'i dbang gi rim pa ni/ /rin chen gsal ba'i sgron me gtan la phab/ /byin rlabs rang byung gnas lugs rig pa'i dbang*/ /kun las mchog gyur ngo mtshar e ma ho/ /grol byed khrid kyi rim pa bstan pa ni/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i lam khrid chen mos te/ /de phyin grol ba'i gdams khrid rmad du byung*/ / lag khrid gsal ba ngo mtshar e ma ho/ /de dag kun gyi rgyab chos rim pa la/ /ye grol sor bzhag mthar phyin dgongs pa bstan/ /chos zad blo 'das mkha' ltar dag pa yin/ /thugs kyi me long da lta'i nyams len bstan/ / dgongs pa rang gnas the tshom bral ba yin/ /don gyi me long bar do'i rang gnad bstan/ /rang snang rang grol mngon par sangs rgyas yin/ /lag khrid snying pos yang rab nyams len bstan/ /chos nyid 'od gsal tshe 'dir mthong ba yin/ /gnad kyi me long rgyab chos chen mo bstan/ /zab cing rgya che'i dgongs don gsal ba yin/ /de ltar rgyab chos don gyi gnas lnga yis/ / snyan brgyud gnad rnams 'gyur med gtan la phab/ /'phyugs med gzer btad gnad 'gag chings su bsdams/ /yang zab snying po'i man ngag thems su bkod/ /gzhan las khyad 'phags snyan brgyud e ma ho/ /de dag kun gyi zab chos srung ma la/ /drag po sum sgril sgrub pa'i zab rgya bstan/ /de yi cha lag dngos grub char 'bebs bkod/ /bar chad sel zhing 'dod dgu kun 'grub pas/ /gter bdag dam can sgrub pa e ma ho/ /de ltar bshad rgyud chos sde sum cu lnga/ /snyan brgyud zab mo don gyi chos sde bcu/ /srung ma'i sgrub pa don gyi chos sde gnyis/ /dkar chag nyid dang bsdoms pa'i mdo chings la/ /zab mo yang tig chos sde bzhi bcu brgyad/ /gsang chen nges pa don gyi snying por bkod/ /theg pa'i yang zhun btus pa e ma ho/ /tshul 'di rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rmad byung las/ /tha ma don dam nges pa'i 'khor lo mchog /de las gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rtse/

/bla med bskyed rdzogs thun mong zung 'jug las/ /mchog tu gsang ba rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas/ /sems sde klong sde man ngag sde gsum las/ /mchog tu zab pa man ngag snying po'i sde/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla na med bzhi las/ /don gyi snying po gcig bsdus bla med skor/ /bshad brgyud snyan brgyud don gyi yang zab bcud/ /ma lus kun bsdus 'dir gcig gsal bar bya/ /'di 'dra'i zab chos yid bzhin rin po che/ /'jig rten khams na bkon pa'i man ngag mchog /bde gshegs khams de mngon sum ltar yod pas/ /srid pa tha ma'i dam chos e ma ho/ / 'di dang su 'phrad tshe 'dir srid mtsho brgal/ /rnam grol mya ngan 'das pa'i gling du phyin/ /thar pa'i byang chub chos sku rang las rnyed/ /rdos bcas lus la rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs/ /don dam nam mkha' 'dra ba'i chos kyi sgo/ /dri med 'od gsal nyi ma'i snying pos mdzes/ /snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das yongs la khyab/ /rin chen byang chub sems legs e ma ho/ /'di 'dra'i tshul dang su 'phrad skal ba rab/ /nyams su len tshad rig 'dzin sems dpa' ste/ /snying po'i don ston bla ma sangs rgyas dngos/ /'gro ba'i don la byon pa e ma ho/ kho bo'i dpal mgon rig 'dzin thugs rje can/ /bi ma mi tra bde gshegs sprul pa dngos/ /gangs ri'i yul du deng sang dngos su byon/ /de dang bdag mjal 'di 'dra'i zab chos thob/ /nyin dang mtshan bsam bka' drin bsam las 'das/ /dad gus tshad med snying nas mos gus bskyed/ /de yi dbang gis byin rlabs rgyun chad med/ /lta dgongs ting 'dzin rtogs pa ngang gis 'char/ /'du 'bral med do chos nyid don gyi dbyings/ /gzhi bde'i lam na blo bde rgyun mi chad/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' rab 'byams te/ /sna tshogs rang grol chos nyid gtan yul zin/ /phyi rabs rjes su 'jug pa'i skal ldan rnams/ /yi ge 'di la rtag tu gces spras mdzod/

kho bo'i nyams len snying gi zab chos rnams/ /'di ru mngon phyung gsal bar bkod pa yin/ /zab mo yang tig gsang ba'i thems 'di rnams/ /sngags bdag gza' dang dam can gsum la gtad/ /yi ge 'di la 'dra min 'chos pa dang*/ /brtsams gzhi 'thu zhing lung med gzhan la ston/ /snod min rnams la ston na bka' chad phobs/ /srog chod dbugs phrogs mig 'bras thang la phrul/ /skal ldan bstan pa'i bdag po byung ba'i tshe/ /gsang ba byin la dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /brgyud gsum bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*/ / bka' srung dam can rnams kyi mthu dpal dang*/ /mkha' 'gro grub pa rnams kyi bden tshig dang*/ /bdag gi las smon bsod nams stobs dag gis/ / zab mo yang tig bstan pa dar bar shog /skal bzang rnams kyi thar lam sgron me shog /rtag tu gzhan phan yid bzhin nor bu shog /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /zab mo yang tig gi dkar chag nyi zla gza' skar zhes bya ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi gnas la mang du thos pa'i blo gros rgya che zhing*/ gsang chen nges pa'i rgyud lung man ngag gi don la legs par sbyangs pa'i blo mig can/ theg pa rgyal po'i rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ kun tu bzang po'i khang bzangs zla ba chu shel gyis 'tsher ba/ rin chen 'od kyi snye ma'i rgyal mtshan gyis mtho ba'i gnas su/ ston dus me tog dang 'bras bur smin pa'i tshe legs par sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (12)zab mo yang tig gi dkar chag nyi zla gza' skar/ -PAGE 354--PAGE 355--PAGE 352-
